## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## Our 2025 Sustainability Report is Here

From innovation to impact- see how we’re advancing solutions that power more sustainable products.

## SHOKLESS™ systems for electric vehicle (EV) batteries
## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

[Find out more][81]

high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

# MOVING IN UNISON

We work as a flexible, attentive extension of your team; we offer the contract research organization
services you need to move your molecule from preclinical to Phase I, Phase II, and beyond.

[ Contact Us ][14]

transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

No important medicine is developed by one person. Early phase drug development takes teams of

work hard, have fun, and innovate continuously, getting medicines to the people who need them,
faster.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

# Making the best Diaphragm Seal Systems

### We’re a leading global manufacturer of Diaphragm Seal Systems

Founded in 1957 in Dordrecht, the Netherlands, Badotherm has developed itself into a leading global
manufacturer and solution provider of Diaphragm Seal Systems.

Diaphragm Seal Systems are built to protect pressure instruments by separating the sensitive
pressure measuring element from the harsh process conditions in the heavy and demanding
petrochemical and chemical industries. This we do with all leading pressure transmitter brands, as
well with our own manufactured pressure gauges.

Next to our vast range of standard Diaphragm Seal Systems, we specialize in the engineering and
manufacturing of specials Diaphragm Seal Systems, being for extreme temperature, challenging spans
and pressures, a wide variety of exotic and high end materials, as well as custom designs seals.

continuously improve our services by investing in skilled and trained employees as well as a
high-tech working environment and equipment. As manufacturer, we understand the importance of good
maintenance services to ensure a durable, safe and long-lasting measurement.

The Badotherm knowledge base is a self-serve online library of information about products, services,
and specific topics. There are several kinds of information made available in whitepapers, product
datasheets, manuals and other resource types. Some products are visualized though 3D animated PDF
files to have a 360° view of the product.

[Knowledge Center][78]

# Accessibility

At Badotherm, we understand that quick and reliable support is essential when it comes to diaphragm
seal systems and pressure measurement. Our team of specialists is always easy to contact and direct
available to solve any problems you may encounter and provide guidance throughout the process.
As a manufacturer, we have complete control over the entire manufacturing and assembly process,
ensuring that we can offer quick responses to engineering questions and adjust lead times to meet
your requirements. If you’re facing challenges with your diaphragm seal systems, contact Badotherm
today. Let us deliver on our promise of great service and support.

### We’re a leading global manufacturer of Diaphragm Seal Systems

Founded in 1957 in Dordrecht, the Netherlands, Badotherm has developed itself into a leading global
manufacturer and solution provider of Diaphragm Seal Systems.

Diaphragm Seal Systems are built to protect pressure instruments by separating the sensitive
pressure measuring element from the harsh process conditions in the heavy and demanding
petrochemical and chemical industries. This we do with all leading pressure transmitter brands, as
well with our own manufactured pressure gauges.

Next to our vast range of standard Diaphragm Seal Systems, we specialize in the engineering and
manufacturing of specials Diaphragm Seal Systems, being for extreme temperature, challenging spans
and pressures, a wide variety of exotic and high end materials, as well as custom designs seals.

high-tech working environment and equipment. As manufacturer, we understand the importance of good
maintenance services to ensure a durable, safe and long-lasting measurement.

The Badotherm knowledge base is a self-serve online library of information about products, services,
and specific topics. There are several kinds of information made available in whitepapers, product
datasheets, manuals and other resource types. Some products are visualized though 3D animated PDF
files to have a 360° view of the product.

[Knowledge Center][78]

# Accessibility

At Badotherm, we understand that quick and reliable support is essential when it comes to diaphragm
seal systems and pressure measurement. Our team of specialists is always easy to contact and direct
available to solve any problems you may encounter and provide guidance throughout the process.
As a manufacturer, we have complete control over the entire manufacturing and assembly process,
ensuring that we can offer quick responses to engineering questions and adjust lead times to meet
your requirements. If you’re facing challenges with your diaphragm seal systems, contact Badotherm
today. Let us deliver on our promise of great service and support.

# Ready-to-use Produkte für Filmüberzüge Tablettierungen Dragierungen Einfärbungen Clean Label

[Ready-to-use Film Coating Systeme][37]


**Spezialisiert auf feste orale Darreichungsformen.**
** Exzellente Hilfsstoffmischungen für Filmüberzüge, Tablettierungen,
Kapselbefüllungen & Einfärbungen. Kundenspezifisch & ready-to-use.
Für pharmazeutische Anwendungen, Nahrungsergänzungsmittel & Kosmetika.
**

[Mehr erfahren][38]
[Folge einem manuell hinzugefügten Link][39]

Für feste orale Darreichungsformen. Für schnelllösliche, magensaftresistente oder verzögerte
Freisetzungsprofile.

## Zweitlieferant Strategie.

## Service
* Entwicklung und Produktion
* Umformulierung bestehender Tabletten-Rezepturen
* Umstellung von Inhouse-Rezepturen auf ready-to-use Systeme
* Austausch unerwünschter Rohstoffe
* Abhilfe bei Produktionsproblemen
* Farbanpassung/-nachstellung
* Technische Unterstützung vor Ort
* Beratung, Schulung, Training
* Scale-up

[Mehr erfahren][57]

## Vorteile ready-to-use Produkte

Einfach, schnell und zuverlässig einsetzbar. Fertigformulierte Pulvermischung einfach der
bestehenden Tablettiermasse beimischen oder in Wasser dispergieren, um eine Filmüberzugssuspension
herzustellen.

Ihre Vorteile:
* kundenspezifische Formulierung
* 1 Produkt, weniger Dokumentation
* in einem Schritt anwendbar
* schnelles und einfaches Handling
* gleichbleibende und reproduzierbare Qualität
* niedriges Lieferkettenrisiko
* einfache Logistik
* kürzere Produktionszeiten

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

# Working Together for a Healthier World

Through a commitment to innovation, quality and collaboration, we ensure our customers' deliver
better medicines — faster, safer, and with confidence in quality.

[CC_Headers_Level01_Homepage]

At Colorcon, we promise to deliver excellence in every product, every process and every interaction.
Our science-based approach to product development drives innovation. Our people-centric approach to
customers and partners elevates it all.

[About Us][125]

## Partnering Across Industries

In today's dynamic healthcare environment, there is increasing pressure to balance speed to market
and manufacturing efficiency with product innovation and ever-evolving legislation. Choosing the
right partner is critical to your formulation success.

[Industries_Pharma]

### Pharmaceuticals

Our comprehensive suite of products and services includes specialty excipients, film coating
systems, controlled release formulation, and controlled atmosphere packaging.

[Discover More][126]
[Industries_Nutra]

### Nutraceuticals & Dietary Supplements

We help develop the clean label tablets, capsules and gummies consumers love — leveraging the
expertise and discipline we have honed over 60+ years in the pharmaceutical industry.

[Discover More][127]
[Industries_Animal Health]

### Animal Health

Our innovative solutions enhance palatability, ensuring animals "receive" or "take" their
medications and supplements willingly. As a NASC Preferred Supplier, we're committed to delivering
high-quality ingredients for the animal health industry.

[Discover More][128]

## Innovation From the Inside Out

Colorcon's comprehensive suite of products provides stability and protection for all aspects of
formulation. From the core to coating to packaging, they safeguard your medications and ensure
efficacy and reliability throughout shelf life.

Partner with our team to infuse your products with these industry-leading solutions proven to meet
the evolving needs of patients and professionals worldwide.

[Offerings_02]

### Core
### Excipients

The foundation of solid oral dosage forms, our core excipients deliver the active ingredient and
provide essential properties for drug stability.

[View Product Details][129]
[Offerings_03]

### Controlled
### Release

We specialize in technologies that ensure the controlled release of active ingredients, optimizing
therapeutic effectiveness and patient compliance.

[View Product Details][130]
[Offerings_04]

### FILM
### COATINGS

We offer high-quality film coatings that protect medications from environmental factors, improve
appearance and enhance taste and texture.

[View Product Details][131]
[Offerings_05]

### Controlled Atmosphere Packaging

Our innovative packaging solutions maintain medication integrity by controlling the internal
atmosphere, preventing degradation and ensuring product safety.

[View Product Details][132]

## Technical Expertise

Colorcon is more than just a supplier; we're a strategic partner committed to helping our customers
succeed by making the products that improve your products. We understand your unique challenges and
leverage our deep industry knowledge to develop innovative solutions that drive positive change.

# Working Together for a Healthier World

Through a commitment to innovation, quality and collaboration, we ensure our customers' deliver
better medicines — faster, safer, and with confidence in quality.

[CC_Headers_Level01_Homepage]

At Colorcon, we promise to deliver excellence in every product, every process and every interaction.
Our science-based approach to product development drives innovation. Our people-centric approach to
customers and partners elevates it all.

[About Us][125]

## Partnering Across Industries

In today's dynamic healthcare environment, there is increasing pressure to balance speed to market
and manufacturing efficiency with product innovation and ever-evolving legislation. Choosing the
right partner is critical to your formulation success.

[Industries_Pharma]

### Pharmaceuticals

Our comprehensive suite of products and services includes specialty excipients, film coating
systems, controlled release formulation, and controlled atmosphere packaging.

[Discover More][126]
[Industries_Nutra]

### Nutraceuticals & Dietary Supplements

We help develop the clean label tablets, capsules and gummies consumers love — leveraging the
expertise and discipline we have honed over 60+ years in the pharmaceutical industry.

[Discover More][127]
[Industries_Animal Health]

### Animal Health

Our innovative solutions enhance palatability, ensuring animals "receive" or "take" their
medications and supplements willingly. As a NASC Preferred Supplier, we're committed to delivering
high-quality ingredients for the animal health industry.

[Discover More][128]

## Innovation From the Inside Out

Colorcon's comprehensive suite of products provides stability and protection for all aspects of
formulation. From the core to coating to packaging, they safeguard your medications and ensure
efficacy and reliability throughout shelf life.

Partner with our team to infuse your products with these industry-leading solutions proven to meet
the evolving needs of patients and professionals worldwide.

[Offerings_02]

### Core
### Excipients

The foundation of solid oral dosage forms, our core excipients deliver the active ingredient and
provide essential properties for drug stability.

[View Product Details][129]
[Offerings_03]

### Controlled
### Release

We specialize in technologies that ensure the controlled release of active ingredients, optimizing
therapeutic effectiveness and patient compliance.

[View Product Details][130]
[Offerings_04]

### FILM
### COATINGS

We offer high-quality film coatings that protect medications from environmental factors, improve
appearance and enhance taste and texture.

[View Product Details][131]
[Offerings_05]

### Controlled Atmosphere Packaging

Our innovative packaging solutions maintain medication integrity by controlling the internal
atmosphere, preventing degradation and ensuring product safety.

[View Product Details][132]

aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

[Image]
[Image]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

Go directly to: 
[GMP+ Feed Safety Assurance (GMP+ FSA][53][)][54]

[GMP+ Feed Responsibility Assurance (GMP+ FRA)][55]

[More about our scheme][56]

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

# Pellets Manufacture

Innoveau Chemicals Limited, established in 2024, proudly stands as the first pharmaceutical pellet
manufacturing company in Bangladesh. The company is dedicated to producing high-quality pellet
formulations, including controlled-release, sustained-release, and immediate-release varieties.

> Ensuring better health and well-being for communities worldwide
> 
> Innoveau Chemicals Limited

[ View Details ][11]

## Manufacture

## Products

## The production of pharmaceutical pellets involves several key steps, each critical to ensuring
## the quality and efficacy of the final product. Here’s an outline of the typical manufacturing
## process:

## IMMEDIATE RELEASE PELLETS

Immediate release pellets are a type of pharmaceutical dosage form designed to release the active
pharmaceutical ingredient (API) rapidly after administration. Unlike controlled or sustained release
formulations, immediate release pellets dissolve quickly, allowing the medication to be absorbed
into the bloodstream promptly to exert its therapeutic effect.

 

[ Learn More ][12]

## SUSTAINED RELEASE

## EXTENDED PELLETS

Extended or sustained release pellets are a specialized form of pharmaceutical dosage designed to
release the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) slowly and consistently over an extended period.
This controlled release mechanism ensures that the medication maintains therapeutic levels in the
bloodstream for longer durations, reducing the frequency of dosing and enhancing patient compliance.

 

[ Learn More ][13]

## DELAYED RELEASE PELLETS

Delayed release pellets are a type of pharmaceutical dosage form designed to release the active
pharmaceutical ingredient (API) at a specific time after administration, rather than immediately.
This release mechanism is often used to protect the drug from the acidic environment of the stomach,
to target drug release to specific parts of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, or to synchronize with
the body’s circadian rhythms.

 

[ Learn More ][14]

## BLENDED PELLETS

Blended pellets in pharmaceuticals refer to a formulation technique where multiple types of pellets,
each with distinct release characteristics, are combined into a single dosage form. This approach
allows for the simultaneous release of different active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) or varying
release profiles of the same API, providing a versatile and effective means of drug delivery.

 

[ Learn More ][15]

to target drug release to specific parts of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, or to synchronize with
the body’s circadian rhythms.

 

[ Learn More ][14]

## BLENDED PELLETS

Blended pellets in pharmaceuticals refer to a formulation technique where multiple types of pellets,
each with distinct release characteristics, are combined into a single dosage form. This approach
allows for the simultaneous release of different active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) or varying
release profiles of the same API, providing a versatile and effective means of drug delivery.

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents

coating systems that bring solutions.

understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products

## About Us

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

[Read More][41]

Products

## Automotive Refinish

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

[Read More][45]

## Resin

The company produces a range of resins, especially Alkyd resins, which are included in many types of
paints in the way and proportion that suits the needs and requirements of these paints

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

### Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models

We propose measuring AI performance in terms of the length of tasks AI agents can complete. We show
an exponential increase in this time horizon metric over the past 6 years.

][22]
[Read paper ][23] [View repo ][24]

## Featured Research

Our AI evaluations research focuses on assessing broad autonomous capabilities and the ability of AI
systems to accelerate AI R&D. We also study potential AI behavior that threatens the integrity of
evaluations and mitigations for such behavior.

[View all research ][25]
* [General][26]
* [Technical][27]
